description: Use this when someone asks who to captain (or Triple Captain) in Fantasy Premier League (fantasy football) this gameweek. Call it even without their team: it then lists the best captain options in the game. With a team ID (or their team from an earlier chat) it ranks their own players; scope "all" ranks the game.

scope.description: all: the best captains in the game, for general asks; squad: from the user's own team
scope.title: Scope

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: get_captain_picks
title: FPL captain picks
